description: The daemon process: boots the engine, gateway, internal API and cockpit, runs the cadence loop (lane watch, frozen pass, queue-request pass, retention) and owns no recovery, store or alarm policy of its own
createEngine - the ONE workflow-advancement composition (store + spawn manager + ticker) both attachments boot: this daemon and the attached rbtv run verb
The tick algorithm and its per-cadence passes (advance, enforce, warnings, one-live-run, goal-channel start, queued-start notify)
The frozen invariant's tick DRIVER [T1-R15]: hands observation/frozen.js the lane-watch facts once a cadence and decides nothing about what frozen means
The typed-message gateway seam: sender auth, parse, and dispatch injected as a constructor argument - it may not name the store, the spawn path or server-core internals
The daemon-local intent dispatch the CLI and the chat bridge reach through
The one-live-run lease derivation every consumer reads instead of deriving its own
Resolve the calling seat's identity and seat folder from the environment, for callers that cannot ask the daemon
The ONE python interpreter resolver every JS caller that shells to python goes through
The attached run's board - what an attached rbtv run prints and returns
The fire-tool job payloads the queue invokes, with jobcontain.py as the containment wrapper the rest run under
